evidence: The PZT ﬁlm deposited using Ti /H20849Oi–Pr/H208502/H20849DPM/H208502 had 3.1% carbon, while the PZT ﬁlms deposited using TTIP contained a higher amount of carbon, 15.6%. As was the case for the surface morphology, the property of the Ti precursors could be the reason for this difference in the carbon content. The higher carbon content in the TTIP-derived PZT ﬁlms originated from the catalytic decomposition of the TTIP .
